name: hetero-3sku
_comment: G2.1 heterogeneous topology — 10 hosts across 3 SKUs. Loaded when TOPOLOGY_CONFIG points here; homogeneous (NUM_HOSTS identical hosts) stays the reproducibility default. Only fields that differ from the env-var defaults need overriding; absent numeric fields inherit the homogeneous defaults. vcpu/ram are kept uniform (64 vCPU / 256 GB) so the SKUs differ only along the energy axis (P_idle/P_max) and the GPU-affinity axis (gpu count) — the two dimensions G2.1/G2.2 add.
